checks.claim: The submitted application is entered from a browser page and renders the React application.
evidence: index.html:14 loads /src/main.tsx as a module script.
src/main.tsx:1-4 renders App into the browser root element.
src/App.tsx:80-81 calls useEmbeddingWorker from the browser application.

checks.claim: Document and query embeddings are generated in a browser Web Worker with Transformers.js.
evidence: src/hooks/useEmbeddingWorker.ts:40-43 creates a module Web Worker.
src/workers/embedding.worker.ts:41-53 loads the feature-extraction pipeline with a browser device and q8 dtype.
src/App.tsx:266-276 embeds document batches before sending vectors to the API.
src/App.tsx:340-355 embeds the query before searching.

checks.claim: The browser embedding path proves both WebGPU use and WASM fallback.
evidence: src/workers/embedding.worker.ts:69-71 first loads the pipeline with device webgpu.
src/workers/embedding.worker.ts:72-76 retries with device wasm after WebGPU initialization fails.
src/workers/embedding.worker.ts:79-84 reports the selected backend and fallback reason.
src/hooks/useEmbeddingWorker.ts:62-74 exposes the selected backend and load result to the application.

checks.claim: The API creates and opens a SeekDB collection with full text and a 384-dimensional HNSW vector index.
evidence: server/seekdb.ts:35-40 defines the full text index, HNSW dimension, and embeddingFunction: null.
server/seekdb.ts:51-60 creates and opens collections with the same external embedding contract.

checks.claim: Imported browser vectors are written to SeekDB and the index is refreshed after each batch.
evidence: server/index.ts:62-73 validates records and calls collection.upsert with ids, documents, embeddings, and metadata.
server/index.ts:76-86 calls collection.refresh_index and returns write and refresh timings.

checks.claim: Search uses SeekDB native hybrid search with keyword retrieval, KNN retrieval, and RRF ranking.
evidence: server/index.ts:97-120 calls collection.hybridSearch with whereDocument, queryEmbeddings, and RRF configuration.
server/index.ts:121-127 returns the mapped SeekDB result order and database timing.
